messages.content: "John has decided to invest in two different funds. He invested $5000 in Fund A which has an annual return rate of 7% and he plans to keep his money there for 5 years. On the other hand, he invested $8000 in Fund B with an annual return rate of 5% for a period of 7 years. Can you predict the profit John will make from both Fund A and Fund B?"

function.name: investment_predictProfit
function.description: Predict the profit for given investment after specified number of years.

annual_return.description: The annual return rate of the investment. This is a float type value.

years.description: The time period in years for which the investment is made.

message.reasoning_content:
The user is asking for profit predictions for two different investments:
1. Fund A: $5000 investment, 7% annual return, 5 years
2. Fund B: $8000 investment, 5% annual return, 7 years

I need to use the investment_predictProfit function for each investment. The function takes:
- investment_amount (integer)
- annual_return (float)
- years (integer)

For Fund A:
- investment_amount: 5000
- annual_return: 7% = 0.07
- years: 5

For Fund B:
- investment_amount: 8000
- annual_return: 5% = 0.05
- years: 7

I'll make two separate function calls to get the profit predictions for both funds.
